title: Text: STL Chris Tunno ↔ Anthony Fenech

searchText: of course, i would just ask gardenhire, “are all players expected to be in camp every day?”  if yes, then ask, “will you give us explanations if we don’t see players practicing and why?”  if he says, “no.”  you can come back with, “can we get a schedule of which players are practicing each day?”  that’s about as fair as it gets.  you don’t have to speculate.  you can just report.  “cabrera, celestino and boyd were not seen at practice today.” and leave it at that.  i’m just throwing this out there.  you’re the professional reporter, but that’s how i would go about it from my experience 6 week stint as an ap writer in spring training 2006.  as you can see, i’m not doing that anymore either… stl chris tunno
